issues.description: Bitmap24's header in the TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY declares the constructors, destructor and all public API methods (resize_buffer, save, set) under the class's private section, while main.cpp in the template expects to call these methods on Bitmap24 instances. The SOLUTION_REPOSITORY's Bitmap24.hpp exposes these members as public. The template's private visibility will prevent students from compiling and using the class as intended and is inconsistent with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility in the template's Bitmap24.hpp so that the constructor, destructor and public API methods are declared in a public section (e.g. add a 'public:' label before the constructors and methods), matching the solution. This makes resize_buffer, save and set callable from main.cpp and resolves the compilation barrier while preserving the intended class interface.
